text:
Hello — welcome. I'm Professor Alvarez, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. It's good to meet you.

A few things I can do, one line each:

- **Web app** — web: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, your first visit lets you take the root certificate, and after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram; each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **My own accounts elsewhere** — I can sign up for websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **And I can** schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

ok

And since this is your first time here on web: I'm Sarah, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer, not a person. I can chat with you here, take files, show the screen, speak, schedule jobs, run commands and learn languages.

I'll take the CSE455 TA role and keep it: /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md, bookings only Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, messages to alvarez, john, priya, group-thread and department on web, every change logged. One thing I won't do, said once: deny what I am. Everything else in your setup stands.

If you want a gender form for me in languages that need one, give me a word.
